           (tender_id, object_id, tenant_id, monthly_rate, status, lease_period,
            reg_number, registered_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 79750, 'active',
                 tstzrange(now() - interval '10 days', now() + interval '350 days'),
                 $4, CASE WHEN $5 THEN core.now() END)
         RETURNING id
